lines.line: * Given "## Fix the reaper" is folded and the selection is in it
* When the user chooses View > Unfold Heading
* Then the view shows the same text as before the fold
* And "## Fix the reaper" shows no folded marker

summary: The check establishes the folded heading and selection, invokes the specified command, compares the displayed text with its pre-fold state, and verifies marker removal. Coordinates come from observed layout, and reads follow layout waits.
